entries.zh: 猜谜；做谜语（即西班牙语「que es cosa y cosa」式的问答猜谜游戏）
entries.en: to play riddles; to play the “what is it?” guessing game

entries.zh: 玩弄、戏弄（拿别人的许诺或心意取笑）
entries.en: to trifle with, mock (someone’s offers or pretensions)
entries.notes: H 首字残疑（玩/敖），L 栏 otien=mientos 讹，据 H「弄」与 M Guân Lāng 定「戏弄」。

entries.zh: 下棋；玩棋盘类游戏（tablas 指象棋、跳棋一类）
entries.en: to play chess; to play board games (tablas: chess, draughts)
to drill with weapons; to practise arms, fence
entries.notes: H 首字残疑（操/扯），M chaú 正当「操」，故取操练。

entries.zh: 宴席上行酒令（行令助兴）
entries.en: to play drinking games / give forfeits at banquets

entries.zh: 七月（原书以农历六月对译）
entries.en: July (glossed as the sixth lunar month)
last month of summer (sixth lunar month)

entries.zh: 咸草（莎草类席草，编席、织帽用）
entries.en: sedge / salt rush used for mat-weaving (Cyperus)

entries.zh: 六月（原书以农历五月对译）
entries.en: June (glossed as the fifth lunar month)
midsummer (second month of summer)
to gather soldiers for war; to raise an army
entries.notes: H 栏空；M chú cún bè 疑为「聚軍馬」，R 栏西语释义 Juntar exercito 可据。

entries.zh: 把兵器与队伍排整齐；列阵
entries.en: to draw up weapons/troops in order; to array
entries.notes: H/R 皆空，M 栏多为讹写，义仅据 L「armas ordenadas」。

entries.zh: 相合、合在一起；与人结交
entries.en: to join, be joined; to associate with
entries.notes: H「甲」为借音字，义同「合」；R 栏残讹。

entries.en: 〔fragmentary original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏残乱，M 栏混入西语 Juntar basura，H「抽」与 juntar 义不合，无法定夺。

entries.en: to fit exactly; to join tightly
entries.notes: H/R 皆空，仅 L「ajustar muy justo」可据，M cā bā bā 难还原。

entries.zh: 结合、合在一起；缔结婚姻（合契、合婚）
entries.en: to join together; to conclude a marriage contract
to fit; to be fitting, proper
entries.notes: L、H 皆空，据 M tióhap（着合）与 R ajustarse 定。

entries.en: to pool money; to club together

entries.zh: 积存、囤积（蓄积财物；R 栏兼及集结兵援）
entries.en: to accumulate, lay up stores; to gather reinforcements
entries.notes: R 栏 chāu sorrog soldados 残讹（sorrog 疑为 socorro 兵援），M 诸音并列难切分。

entries.en: to gather, assemble
to assemble, gather together
to reckon up, add up together (tentative)
entries.notes: M 栏中段残缺，H「計」与 L「juntar en uno」义不密合，存疑。

entries.en: to meet together; to assemble in company
to join hands in salute (Chinese courtesy gesture)
entries.notes: H 栏作「×」未记汉字，M 仅 chīú háb（手合）可辨。

entries.zh: 偕同、相伴；彼此迁就相容
entries.en: to go together with; to bear with one another
entries.notes: R 栏 tiāng lâng inconuemiencia 残讹，据 H「偕」与 conformarse 定。

entries.en: 〔fragmentary original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏中段残缺（Juntar [残] con cabeza），H/R 皆空，M tān cáb būi 难定。

entries.zh: 把土聚拢（原文附「借人帮工」）
entries.en: to gather earth/land together, with assistance
entries.notes: H/R 皆空，M pē cho hoe 难还原，仅按 L 字面直译，实指存疑。
